name: Lucy
desc:
Lucy is a Gremor NPC.

They appear sprawled out on the floor in [The City of the Drowned](location:the_city_of_the_drowned). They appear to have a grudge against [The Divers](faction:the_divers) and might be slightly insane as they hear voices talking to them.
additional_info: -   Lucy was originally a Canor but was changed to a Gremor for unknown reasons.
